INFINATELY WAR, YOU READY?This isn't a game on a screen. This is a room you walk into, a gun in your hand, and three friends at your side — all of you wearing nothing but a wireless VR headset. Welcome to the FunInVR free-roam shooting arena, where the walls come alive and the mission starts the second you step in. No wires. No boundaries. Just pure, untethered virtual reality.
